scientific_integrity: The classification is proved for every finite nonempty carrier; finite counts are independently checked by code. The underlying representation and strong-density axioms are credited to Holliday.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite total functional centered successful selection frames. Five-world enumeration is exhaustive but no closed form for larger coefficients is asserted. Possible independently equivalent results under choice-theoretic or selection-semantic terminology remain a novelty risk.
title: Tail-coherent rankings and a four-point test for finite strongly dense selection frames
